steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the combo or disconnect power before servicing. Discharge PBA terminals per manual.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Make sure to disconnect the power plug before servicing.

steps.title: Stuck button / panel moisture
steps.body: Verify no button pressed >30 s. Check water on window panel and rear PCB connector.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Verify no button pressed >30 s. Check water on window panel and rear PCB connector.

branches.label: No / fault
branches.oemOutcome: Dry panel, relieve deformation, or replace sub PBA.

steps.title: Repair panel/PBA
steps.oemOutcome: Correct mechanical bind or replace sub PBA.

steps.title: Switch path OK
steps.oemOutcome: No stuck buttons — replace sub PBA if BC2 persists.
